senses.gloss:
r. 1st and 10th cls. (छदति-ते and छदयति, or more commonly छादयति.)
1 To cover, to clothe, to veil, to hide, or remove from view: (आङ् is usually prefixed to the root in these senses.)
2 To march.
(इ) छदि r. 1st cl. (छंदति)
To live or breathe, to be or make strong;
also r. 1st and 10th cls. (छन्दति छंदयति)
To cover, &c. as above.

m. (-दः)
1 A leaf.
2 A wing.
3 A plant: see ग्रन्थिपर्णी.
4 A tree bearing dark blossoms: see तमाल.
E.
छद to cover, &c. aff. घ.

n. (-दं)
A thatch, a roof.
E.
छद to cover, affix घञ्.

n. (-नं)
1 A leaf.
2 A wing.
3 A covering, a sheathe, a scabbard.
4 Cassia.
E.
छद to cover or hide, affix युच्.

n. (-नं)
1 Covering.
2 A covering, a screen, &c.
3 Hiding, concealing.
4 A leaf.
E.
छद to cover, affix ल्यु, and the vowel lengthened.

m. (-त्रः)
A tree, (Symplocos racemosa, Rox.) see भूर्य्य
E.
छद a cover or skin, and पत्र a leaf.

m. (-दिः)
The thatch or roof of a house.
E.
छद to cover, इसि Uṇādi aff.

m. (-सः)
A religious hypocrite, a false brother.
E.
छद्म disguise, and तापस an ascetic.

n. (-द्मं)
1 Trick, deceit.
2 Fraud, dishonesty.
3 Plea, pretext.
4 Masquerade, disguise of person, &c.
E.
छद a cloak, a covering, and मनिन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-शी)
Being in disguise, a player.
E.
छद्म and वेशिन् who wears a dress, &c.

m. (-रः)
1 A tooth.
2 An arbour or bower.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Cut, divided.
2 Covered.
3 Hidden, concealed.
E.
छो to cut, or छद to cover, affix क्त.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Fraudulent, dishonest.
m. (-कः)
A rogue, a cheat.
E.
छद्मन् knavery, ठञ् aff.
